svg.aria-label: Left: fixed validation-window negative log density versus updates. Middle: known quadrant masses and model quadrature masses. Right: final states of 512 MALA chains after 1,000 steps on GridMLE energy with h=0.03. The finite sample cloud and model-integrated masses are separate quantities.
